name: code-archaeologist
description: Select code and see how it evolved commit by commit, and why.

commands.title: Code Archaeologist: Why is this here?

enumDescriptions: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM and similar
codeArchaeologist.provider.markdownDescription:
Request format of the LLM API that writes the notes, summary and verdict.

Easier: [open the Code Archaeologist settings screen](command:codeArchaeologist.openSettings), with one-click presets, a connection test and the keys and tokens in one place.

codeArchaeologist.baseUrl.markdownDescription: LLM API URL, up to the version path, e.g. `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` or `http://localhost:11434/v1` for the OpenAI-compatible format. Empty uses `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` for Gemini and `https://api.openai.com/v1` for OpenAI-compatible.

codeArchaeologist.gitlabUrl.markdownDescription: Your self-hosted GitLab, e.g. `https://gitlab.example.com`. The GitLab token is sent only to gitlab.com and to this address, so set it for any other GitLab, even one with "gitlab" in its name. Remotes on a host named like `gitlab.example.com` are found without it, but read without your token. The token is set by **Code Archaeologist: Set GitLab token** (or `GITLAB_TOKEN`) and needs the `read_api` scope: on GitLab, open **Personal access tokens** and click **Generate legacy token**.

codeArchaeologist.model.markdownDescription: Model that writes the notes, summary and verdict. Empty uses `gemini-3.5-flash` with the Gemini API; each Gemini model has its own free daily quota, and `gemini-3.1-flash-lite` has the largest; the OpenAI-compatible format needs a model id from your API. The API key is set with **Code Archaeologist: Set LLM API key**, or read from `GEMINI_API_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`; a server set in `codeArchaeologist.baseUrl` may need none. Pull requests, reviews and issues are read from GitHub with the token set by **Code Archaeologist: Set GitHub token** (or `GITHUB_TOKEN`); without one GitHub allows 60 requests an hour.
